name: PdxBreadcrumb
description: Navigation breadcrumbs, with overflow collapse and custom separators.
generics: T extends { key: string; label: string }

members.name: maxItems
members.description: Collapse to this many items with an ellipsis.

events.name: pdx-select
events.description: A crumb was chosen: its `key` and the item.

attributes.name: maxitems
attributes.description: Collapse to this many items with an ellipsis.

slots.name: item
slots.description: Renders one crumb: a snippet `item(item, index, isLast)`.

cssParts.name: item
cssParts.description: One crumb, an `<li>`; the last is `aria-current="page"` when a snippet draws it.

cssParts.name: link
cssParts.description: A crumb that leads somewhere: a link with an `href`, a button without one.

cssParts.name: current
cssParts.description: The page you are on, the last crumb, `aria-current="page"`.

cssParts.name: separator
cssParts.description: The glyph between two crumbs, hidden from assistive technology.

cssParts.name: ellipsis
cssParts.description: The button that stands for the crumbs `max-items` collapsed.
